description: This PHP source file defines the ScreenPermissionDao class, responsible for database access operations related to screen permissions in the OrangeHRM system. It includes a method for retrieving permissions based on module name, action URL, and user roles.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling screen permission queries in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.description: Retrieves a list of ScreenPermission objects based on module name, action URL, and user roles.
